docs.title: Jordan's Doriax Engine Docs
docs.text: Welcome to a documentation and API reference for the Doriax Engine, a powerful and flexible C++ 3D/2D Game Engine.

docs.title: What is Doriax Engine?
docs.text:
A lightweight, efficient, and straightforward open-source game engine. Built with data-driven design and ECS architecture for maximum performance. Script in Lua or C++ and deploy to 6 platforms.

Official website: Doriax

docs.title: Why not use the official docs?
docs.text:
As the official docs say

This documentation covers the editor workflow, runtime architecture, core subsystems, build targets, and the current public API surface exposed by the Doriax source tree. Doriax is moving quickly, so the reference pages are written to be practical guides rather than frozen ABI guarantees.

However, especially for c++ the current documentation is sparce and does not give full examples, this is meant to do the opposite, it is designed to be similar to the Unity Engine documentation, meaning (eventually) for every single function or variable is documented WITH a full example.

This would make it so for beginners, it is way easer to get started with working code immediately, without having to look though the currently ~1.2 million! lines of c++ code, to find out how to spawn a entity.

The downside is that it only and will only, ever support c++.

docs.title: Operators
docs.text: Result Method Arguments Description float operator [] size_t i Access component value by index (0 for x, 1 for y, 2 for z, 3 for w). float& operator [] size_t i Access component reference by index (0 for x, 1 for y, 2 for z, 3 for w). Vector4& operator = const Vector4& rkVector Assigns values from another vector. Vector4& operator = const float fScalar Assigns a scalar value to all components. Vector4& operator = const Vector3& rhs Assigns X, Y, and Z components from a 3D vector. bool operator == const Vector4& rkVector Checks component-wise equality with another vector. bool operator != const Vector4& rkVector Checks component-wise inequality with another vector. bool operator < const Vector4& v Returns true if all components are strictly less than target vector's components. bool operator > const Vector4& v Returns true if all components are strictly greater than target vector's components. Vector4 operator + const Vector4& rkVector Performs component-wise addition. Vector4 operator + const float rhs Performs scalar addition. Vector4 operator - const Vector4& rkVector Performs component-wise subtraction. Vector4 operator - const float rhs Performs scalar subtraction. Vector4 operator * const Vector4& rhs Performs component-wise multiplication. Vector4 operator * const float fScalar Performs scalar multiplication. Vector4 operator / const Vector4& rhs Performs component-wise division. Vector4 operator / const float fScalar Performs scalar division. const Vector4& operator + Unary positive operator. Vector4 operator - Unary negation operator. Vector4& operator += const Vector4& rkVector Adds vector in-place. Vector4& operator += const float fScalar Adds scalar in-place. Vector4& operator -= const Vector4& rkVector Subtracts vector in-place. Vector4& operator -= const float fScalar Subtracts scalar in-place. Vector4& operator *= const Vector4& rkVector Component-wise multiplies in-place. Vector4& operator *= const float fScalar Multiplies by scalar in-place. Vector4& operator /= const Vector4& rkVector Component-wise divides in-place. Vector4& operator /= const float fScalar Divides by scalar in-place.
